name: iparq
description: Inspect Parquet compression, encodings and indexes, and Vortex schemas, scan splits and file sizes locally with iParq.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect Parquet and Vortex metadata locally
interface.longDescription: Use iParq's read-only CLI to inspect local Parquet and Vortex storage metadata and return structured results without uploading files.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect the Parquet or Vortex files in this task and explain their storage-level metadata.
